sideA.text:
THIS PACKAGE INCLUDES:

• 20 cards • 1 sticker card

RECON REPORT

It started here, in North America. After COdA, there was chaos. Then the plague hit. The world could not handle back-to-back pandemics. We need to reconnect our supply lines. We need to be on the lookout for any sign of other havens. We need to find more supplies. Perhaps our leaders went here? Too many questions.

Read both sides of this card

P1-01 a then keep it in the reserve.

sideB.text:
RIGHT NOW!

Open the following doors if you have not done so already:

66 39

You have connected a new city: Chicago.

• Add the Player cards for Chicago to the Player discard pile.

• Add the Infection cards for Chicago to the Game End area.

• Put the other Player and Infection cards included in this package into the reserve.

• Finally, give the "Decontamination Kit" Unrationed Event card to a player to add to their hand.

P1-01b

rules: On opening the package, open doors 66, J, 23, L, and 39 if they are not already open.
Chicago is the new city. Both Chicago Player cards (P1-03b and P1-04b) go to the Player discard pile.
Both Chicago Infection cards go to the Game End area, so they cannot be drawn this game.
Every other Player card and Infection card in the package goes to the reserve.
Give the Decontamination Kit Unrationed Event (P1-02b) to a player to add to their hand.
Keep this report in the reserve after both sides have been read.
notes: Card id 900. Printed codes P1-01a and P1-01b.

The face says 20 cards and 1 sticker card. The 17 folders are 20 physical cards once the duplicate Infection cards are counted. The Workshop splits the one sticker card into Weak, Impatient, and Exhausted.
Door 66 is the North America map. J and 23 are Establish Supply Line. L and 39 are Search.
Side A spells the earlier virus COdA. The Atlanta search spells the same name CCdA.
